name: dreamify-app
description: A full-stack analytics platform for data processing, visualization, and insights generation

scripts.dev:backend: cd ../dreamify-backend && (command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1 && python -m app.main || python3 -m app.main)
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.check:timestamp: cd ../dreamify-backend && python scripts/check_timestamp_policy.py && cd ../dreamify-frontend/frontend && npm run check:timestamp
scripts.ci:check: npm run lint && npm run check:timestamp && npm run test

author: Dreamify App Team
